implementation: Explicit bounded plan/apply/cancel development CLI, exclusive instance ownership, installed-head-only checks; no live runtime, model, native secret or device calls.
Immutable plan and verified pre-prune SQLite/object snapshot binding. Resume verifies manifest SHA, every file, registry, integrity, original instance/schema and original target bodies.
Single-time capture pairs cutoff and plan creation time under real SystemClock. Preview remains non-executable.

Per-run short transaction rechecks source, pending approvals, unresolved effect/cost/work/outbound, leases, pins and legacy configuration before clearing body. Related source/fee changes can protect a run without changing the body fingerprint.

Body hashes, structured result/event pruning markers, status/effect/error and correlation metadata, run/target progress and prune audit commit together. Conversation, ledger, source and object references remain untouched.
Real process exits before commit and before final completion show rollback/resume without duplicate prune audits. Interrupted v12 DDL rolls back and retains verified v11 schema snapshots.

Pending targets have a database partial unique constraint and shared eligibility protection. Explicit cancellation releases only pending targets, preserves committed pruning and backup, is immutable/idempotent and remains possible after clock rollback.

Snapshot completed before batch persistence is deliberately not reused: retry needs a new backup destination to avoid omitting intervening unrelated writes. No partial or orphan backup is overwritten.

Restore shares verify_snapshot, locks the destination for first/repeated recovery, rejects live targets, unverified WAL/journals and malformed repeated-restore reports; does not touch unrelated existing directories.
External plan publication cannot overwrite a competing file; cleanup failure cannot strand the instance lock. Workbench own assets v18 show body-pruned state; doctor reports prepared batches only.

full.worker_restart: disabled so an unexpected worker crash fails instead of stranding the scheduler

development_failures.reason: Four failures and a worker crash were followed by all remaining workers waiting in xdist get/run_one_test for several minutes. Preserved read-only worker stacks, ended this isolated test process tree; never counted as a full pass.

Independent process tests also exposed the same real-clock defect.
New test fixture passed duplicate kind arguments to generic query; changed fixture to explicit SQL audit query.
Two-run fixture reused inbound idempotency key. Added a genuinely independent second request; no production transition rules changed.
Narrowed plan list type and annotated UoW/Record callbacks; no type ignores.
Reformatted versioned workbench HTML, then repeated static and packaging verification.
